scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
other_conditions: Must have aggregate marks within the top 1% of the Class XII examination of any State/Central Education Board and be pursuing B.Sc., B.S., Integrated M.Sc./M.S. courses in Basic or Natural Sciences
Must have secured a rank within the top 10,000 in JEE (IIT) or AIPMT and be pursuing B.Sc., B.S., Integrated M.Sc./M.S. courses in Basic or Natural Sciences

Must have aggregate marks within the top 1% of the Class XII examination and be pursuing Integrated M.S. courses in Basic or Natural Sciences at IISERs, NISER, DAE Centre for Basic Sciences‑University of Mumbai, or Visva‑Bharati, Shanti Niketan
Must be selected under Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY) and be pursuing Bachelor or Master level courses in Natural Sciences

Must be a National Talent Search Examination (NTSE) scholar, Jagadish Bose National Science Talent Search (JBNSTS) scholar, or an International Olympiad medalist and be pursuing Bachelor or Master level courses in Natural Sciences

Only courses in the listed Basic and Natural Science subjects (e.g., Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, etc.) are eligible; courses such as Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Computer Science, and distance‑education programmes are not supported
benefits_summary: Annual scholarship of ₹80,000 (₹5,000 per month) plus a ₹20,000 summer mentorship grant, transferred via DBT to the scholar’s State Bank of India account.
documents_required: First page of SBI passbook (account number and name)
